description: This file defines functions, macros, enums, and constants for managing Git attributes within the libgit2 library, including attribute state checks, retrieval, iteration, and cache management.

methods.name: git_attr_value
methods.description: Returns the value type of a given attribute, indicating if it is true, false, unspecified, or has a string value.

methods.name: git_attr_get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific Git attribute for a given path in a repository.

methods.name: git_attr_get_many
methods.description: Retrieves multiple Git attribute values for a given path in a repository.

methods.name: git_attr_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over all Git attributes for a specific path, invoking a callback for each.

methods.name: git_attr_cache_flush
methods.description: Clears the cached Git attributes, forcing reloading from disk.

methods.name: git_attr_add_macro
methods.description: Adds a macro definition for attribute evaluation.
